description: This file defines the UnvoidHandler interface in the org.openmrs.api.handler package, which is responsible for handling the 'unvoid' logic for entities that implement the Voidable interface within the OpenMRS project. It specifies a method to perform unvoid actions, typically setting void-related fields to null, and is used in conjunction with AOP advice to manage unvoid operations across services.

classes.name: UnvoidHandler
classes.description: An interface defining a contract for unvoid operations on Voidable objects in the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Method to perform the unvoid operation on a Voidable object, resetting void fields to null. It is invoked around unvoid methods, typically via AOP advice.
